# sngl build on android builds without Gradle when the gradle option is left
# unset, and runs no JVM: kotlinc and d8 are the native builds from
# sngl-lang/android-tools and the APK is signed in Go. With nothing on PATH
# and no JAVA_HOME, there is no java for a step to have run.

env PATH=
env JAVA_HOME=
sngl build --platform=android --lang=kotlin app.sngl
[toolchain] exists app

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

ui.window(title="Hello") {
    ui.text(value="hello")
}
-- testrun/build/android/kotlin/app.sngl/1 --
sha256:59f208ee1df62ca2588f91e901ac2254
{}
